summary: No edge protection by lift shaft, floor 5
english: There is no edge protection near the lift shaft on Tower B, floor 5.
original: टावर बी पाँचवीं मंज़िल पर लिफ्ट शाफ्ट के पास किनारे पर कोई सुरक्षा नहीं है।
action: Barricade the shaft opening and fit edge protection before work resumes.

reports.original: टावर बी पाँचवीं मंज़िल पर लिफ्ट शाफ्ट के पास किनारे पर कोई सुरक्षा नहीं है।
reports.english: There is no edge protection near the lift shaft on Tower B, floor 5.

reports.original: लिफ्ट के गड्ढे के पास जाली नहीं है, डर लगता है।
reports.english: There is no net near the lift pit; it is frightening.

english: The crane operator is lifting without a signalman.
original: கிரேன் ஆபரேட்டர் சிக்னல் மேன் இல்லாமல் தூக்குகிறார்.
action: Pause lifts until a trained signalman is posted.

reports.original: கிரேன் ஆபரேட்டர் சிக்னல் மேன் இல்லாமல் தூக்குகிறார்.
reports.english: The crane operator is lifting without a signalman.

english: Trucks are reversing near the gate with no one guiding them.
original: ଗେଟ୍ ପାଖରେ ଟ୍ରକ୍ ପଛକୁ ଯାଉଛି, କେହି ଗାଇଡ୍ କରୁନାହାନ୍ତି।
action: Post a banksman at the gate for all reversing vehicles.

reports.original: ଗେଟ୍ ପାଖରେ ଟ୍ରକ୍ ପଛକୁ ଯାଉଛି, କେହି ଗାଇଡ୍ କରୁନାହାନ୍ତି।
reports.english: Trucks are reversing near the gate with no one guiding them.

summary: Untaped wire joint lying in water
english: The wire joint near the pump has no tape and is lying in water.
original: पंप के पास तार के जोड़ पर टेप नइखे, पानी में पड़ल बा।
action: Isolate the pump circuit and replace the joint with a sealed connector.
fixNote: Joint replaced with sealed connector, cable raised on hooks.

reports.original: पंप के पास तार के जोड़ पर टेप नइखे, पानी में पड़ल बा।
reports.english: The wire joint near the pump has no tape and is lying in water.

english: New workers have not been given helmets; six people are without them.
original: Naye labour ko helmet nahi mila, 6 log bina helmet ke.
action: Issue helmets from store before the next shift.

reports.original: Naye labour ko helmet nahi mila, 6 log bina helmet ke.
reports.english: New workers have not been given helmets; six people are without them.

summary: Camp water tank empty in afternoon
english: The water tank at the camp is empty; there is no water in the afternoon.
original: ক্যাম্পে জলের ট্যাংক খালি, দুপুরে জল নেই।
action: Refill the tank and schedule a second afternoon fill.
fixNote: Tank refilled; second daily fill added at 1 pm.

reports.original: ক্যাম্পে জলের ট্যাংক খালি, দুপুরে জল নেই।
reports.english: The water tank at the camp is empty; there is no water in the afternoon.

summary: Torn safety net by staircase, floor 3
english: The safety net near the staircase on Tower B, floor 3, is torn.
original: टावर बी तीसरी मंज़िल पर सीढ़ी के पास जाली फटी है।
action: Replace the net section and inspect nets on all floors.

reports.original: टावर बी तीसरी मंज़िल पर सीढ़ी के पास जाली फटी है।
reports.english: The safety net near the staircase on Tower B, floor 3, is torn.

summary: Soil heap too close to pit edge
english: The soil heap has been placed too close to the excavation edge.
original: ଖୋଳା ଗାତ ପାଖରେ ମାଟି ଗଦା ବହୁତ ପାଖରେ ରଖାଯାଇଛି।
action: Move spoil at least 1 m back from the edge.

reports.original: ଖୋଳା ଗାତ ପାଖରେ ମାଟି ଗଦା ବହୁତ ପାଖରେ ରଖାଯାଇଛି।
reports.english: The soil heap has been placed too close to the excavation edge.

english: The cover over the open shaft on Tower B, floor 7, has been removed.
original: Tower B floor 7 pe open shaft ka cover hata hua hai.
action: Refit and fix the cover so it cannot be lifted off.

reports.original: Tower B floor 7 pe open shaft ka cover hata hua hai.
reports.english: The cover over the open shaft on Tower B, floor 7, has been removed.
